Author: FunkyJumbo
Name: Raid Companion
Punchline: Your live DPS, rDPS and party DPS, right in the server info bar.
Description:
Shows your real-time DPS, party DPS or FFLogs-style rDPS in the server info bar, with your rank, role comparison, pace and enrage timer. Includes a live breakdown window, a compact party meter, graphs, pull history with comparisons, GCD analysis, gauge overcap, positionals, rotation errors, DoT uptime, overheal, tank swaps, party mitigation, party deaths with their cause, failed mechanics, progression tracking, party DPS checks (built in for extremes and savage raids), an opener practice for every job and an opener editor to make and share your own. Works on its own, reading the fight straight from the game. Available in English, French and German (and Al Bhed).

Commands:
/raidcompanion (or /rcomp) - open / close the main window
/raidcompanion config - settings
/raidcompanion history - main window on the History tab
/raidcompanion toggle - cycle DPS, pDPS, rDPS
/raidcompanion compact - open / close the compact meter
/raidcompanion opener - open / close the opener practice
/raidcompanion opener compact - opener practice in its compact view
/raidcompanion opener full - opener practice in its full window
/raidcompanion opener edit - opener editor
/raidcompanion preset <number|name|next> - switch the server bar preset
Changelog:
- Combo errors are now rotation errors, with errors of their own for Paladin, Warrior, Dark Knight and Gunbreaker: buffs that ran out unused, actions used without Surging Tempest or Darkside, Delirium and Gnashing Fang combos broken, lost continuations, a wasted The Blackest Night, and more (hover the "?" for the list).
- Server bar: the two rank elements are now one. Tick Rank for your rank in the party, and click its example in the settings to switch to your rank in your role.
- Screenshots: a camera in the title bar of the main window (instead of the right click on its tabs) and of the opener editor.
